history.text: Write a highly detailed, descriptive prompt of this image in English for an AI text-to-image generator (such as Midjourney, DALL-E, or Stable Diffusion). Describe the objects, background, style, lighting, color palette, and mood in detail. Do NOT include any introductory or concluding conversational text. Do not say 'Here is the prompt' or similar. Output ONLY the raw description of the image.

A young East Asian man with dark hair is taking a selfie in a room with two framed mirrors. He is wearing a simple white t-shirt and a white wristband with two black stripes on his right arm. The man is looking up and to the left, slightly past the camera, with a pensive or thoughtful expression. His right arm is raised, holding a smartphone horizontally to capture the selfie. The mirrors behind him reflect the room, showing more of the white walls, wooden frames of the mirrors, and what appears to be part of a room interior with furniture and possibly other people, though they are indistinct. The lighting is soft and slightly diffused, creating a gentle glow on the man's face and the white walls. The overall color palette is dominated by white, with accents of wood brown from the mirror frames and the blueish tint of the mirror reflections. The mood is intimate and casual, like a candid moment captured by the subject himself. The image has a slightly grainy, retro aesthetic, possibly due to the camera or editing. The perspective is from a slightly low angle, looking up at the man.
